newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P cuts Metals Manufactures to BBB+.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P cuts Metals Manufactures to BBB+.

text.p: Standard & Poors said on Monday it had lowered its long-term rating on Metal Manufactures Ltd to BBB-plus from A-minus and had affirmed its A-2 short-term rating.

The ratings agency said the downgrade reflected heightened levels of competition in the core cable manufacturing operations, structural changes in electricity distribution markets, lower underlying demand from the pay TV cable rollout, and continued weak profit margins arising from Metals Manufacture's construction and industrial product businesses.
On August 13, Metal Manufactures announced a 20 percent lower half year net profit of A$15.7 million. Metal Manufactures is about 61.2 percent owned by BICC Ltd.
Metal Manufactures shares closed steady at A$2.85.
